mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit to install a gas line for a range in Surprise, AZ?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in most municipalities, including Surprise, AZ, a permit is typically required for new gas line installations or modifications to existing gas lines. This ensures that the work complies with local building codes and safety standards. A licensed plumbing contractor will be familiar with the permitting process and can help you obtain the necessary permits before starting the installation.
